rule: Recipes are transparent genesis-allocation presets only. They never bypass the Worldz Safe Launch Standard, alter Fee Flow V3 creator retention or Worldz-internal routing, or imply mainnet availability.

recipes.label: Creator Launch
recipes.description: Balanced creator allocation with public/community and liquidity kept substantial.
recipes.fixedFeeFlowNote: Worldz Fee Flow V3 remains unchanged.

recipes.label: Community Launch
recipes.description: More genesis supply directed to community/public distribution.
recipes.fixedFeeFlowNote: Worldz Fee Flow V3 remains unchanged.

recipes.label: Holder Rewards
recipes.description: Community-heavy distribution with growth capacity for holder-focused programs.
recipes.fixedFeeFlowNote: Worldz Fee Flow V3 remains unchanged.

recipes.label: Liquidity Growth
recipes.description: Higher genesis liquidity allocation while preserving community distribution.
recipes.fixedFeeFlowNote: Worldz Fee Flow V3 remains unchanged.

recipes.label: Buyback Focus
recipes.description: Balanced genesis allocation for a project that may later use a separately disclosed and proven buyback program.
recipes.fixedFeeFlowNote: Fee Flow V3 has no automatic fixed buyback deduction. Any buyback or burn requires its own disclosed source, route, approval and WorldzProof.

recipes.label: Impact Launch
recipes.description: Growth allocation can support separately disclosed impact programs without reducing public proof requirements.
recipes.fixedFeeFlowNote: Fee Flow V3 keeps Impact / Charity at 10% of the Worldz contribution; this recipe does not change that internal lane.

recipes.label: Fair Launch
recipes.description: Low creator allocation with stronger liquidity and public distribution.
recipes.fixedFeeFlowNote: Worldz Fee Flow V3 remains unchanged.

recipes.label: Custom
recipes.description: Start from the current values and edit within enforced Worldz limits.
recipes.fixedFeeFlowNote: All Safe Launch limits and Fee Flow V3 creator-retention/internal-routing rules remain enforced.
